summary: Join our Software (CE-SW) group to develop and improve software ecosystems for Arm's next generation architectures and systems.
responsibilities: Active involvement in software design and test of reference application processor firmware
Low-level software development, testing, and debugging on various platforms
Creating software stacks for Arm's reference platforms for future Arm devices
required_skills: Excellent C/C++ programming skills with ability to add significant new functionality, analyse and fix complex defects
Demonstrated experience with software testing or software development
Expertise in application and low-level systems, with strong understanding of system architecture (preferably ARM)
Proficiency in Linux/Windows operating systems and driver development is preferred
nice_to_have_skills: Experience with Python programming and writing shell scripts
Basic understanding of the Linux kernel, system software and device drivers, and Android internals
Familiarity with open-source project development cycles and contribution processes
Experience of software profiling, instrumentation, and optimization
